# RawSunArt — Lacey Rawson

> Custom watercolor tattoo artist and fine artist in Dublin, Ohio (Columbus metro). Private studio inside AION Tattoo. Original work only: no flash, no copies.

## Who
- Artist: Lacey Rawson. Watercolor is her signature; also botanical, fine line, abstract, and black & grey tattoos. Fine art practice in watercolor, charcoal, ink, and ceramics.
- Business name: RawSunArt. Instagram: @raw.sun.art (the periods are part of the handle).

## Where
- Private studio inside AION Tattoo, 2719 Sawbury Blvd, Dublin, OH 43235. About twenty minutes from downtown Columbus.
- This is the only place she tattoos in the region. Serves Columbus, Dublin, Powell, Worthington, Hilliard, Upper Arlington, Westerville.
- Open to guest spots and events in other regions by arrangement.

## Hours
- Wednesday–Saturday, 12–6. Additional hours by appointment only.

## Pricing and booking
- $250/hr, one-hour minimum; larger projects are quoted. Typical bands: $250–400, $400–700, $700–1,200, $1,200+.
- $100 deposit reserves the appointment and is credited to the final price. Non-refundable for no-shows; 48-hour cancellation notice.
- No pre-booking sketches. Design happens after the deposit; that is what the deposit reserves.
- She does not copy another artist's work. Bring references; she interprets them into an original piece.
- Book via the inquiry form at https://rawsunart.com/#inquiry, by phone or text at 614-858-5574, or by email at lacey@rawsunart.com.
